name: subagent-audit
description: Transparency for native subagents: audit records, git-based file attribution, scope checks, chat receipts and a /subagents pane.

receipts.title: Chat receipts
receipts.description: Write a short audit notice into the chat when a subagent finishes. The model never reads it.

gitAttribution.title: Git file attribution
gitAttribution.description: Compare git status when a subagent starts and ends to see which files it changed. Runs git locally; waits up to 1.5 s before a subagent starts.
